== Source, printing and text-state verification (Story 386) ==
The [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-world-championship-bryan-mischke-ds-aobs/ published Players Committee decklist] was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Mischke DS AOBS.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card articles linked in the table. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114020153/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-world-championship-bryan-mischke-ds-aobs.html Players Committee decklist]. The download's File page attributes the XML to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The download contains 60 constructed-card entries. Its SHA-256 is <code>9d57ba0834667a410733e1cc80249ee6810ececf80113692f846244f18c68bd7</code>; the download bytes were retained. The article lists 60 constructed cards and 28 outside-deck cards. Each outside-deck XML identity is counted separately; a card outside the deck is placed in its own card-type group when it is not a Defensive Shield.
